you don’t.⁣⁣⁣⁣

Here’s an S-Tier forearm exercise (with multiple variations) I thought up a couple months ago that actually makes you WANT to train forearms. ⁣⁣⁣⁣

Tempted to Patent this one before a gen z’er gains 600,000 followers posting a 7 sec clip in 2 mins when this took me 2 hours lmao.⁣⁣⁣⁣

That’s bodybuilding.⁣⁣⁣⁣

Lol who else can IMMEDIATELY tell someone didn’t write their caption? ( I wrote this btw)⁣⁣⁣⁣
⁣⁣⁣⁣
Instead of asking ⁣⁣⁣⁣
“why don’t I have better genetics?”⁣⁣⁣⁣

“What might the logbook of someone who intentionally grew their forearms actually look like?”⁣⁣⁣⁣

And if this caption looks like it was written by someone with debilitating ADHD...⁣⁣⁣⁣
⁣⁣⁣⁣
That’s because it was.⁣⁣⁣⁣
⁣⁣⁣⁣
Enjoy.⁣⁣⁣⁣
